title: Hyperspherical Contrastive Representations Unlock Planning and Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2610.20409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a self-supervised reinforcement learning algorithm that learns to build towers of up to eight cubes from scratch, without prior data, rewards, demonstrations, or pretrained models. Our method, Contrastive Planning via Spherical Linear Interpolation (C-Slerp), uses contrastive representations as reusable building blocks and repeatedly composes them to infer a sequence of intermediate waypoints. Under our hyperspherical parameterization, the learned representations allow intermediate waypoints to be inferred in closed form through spherical linear interpolation, without training a separate high-level policy or performing graph search. Importantly, the representation geometry also tells us how to adjust the number of waypoints based on the difficulty of each goal-reaching problem. translated_title: 超球面对比表示解锁规划与探索
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种自监督强化学习算法，能够从零开始学习搭建高达八个立方体的塔，而无需先验数据、奖励、演示或预训练模型。我们的方法——通过球面线性插值进行对比规划——将对比表示作为可复用的构建模块，并反复组合它们来推断一系列中间路径点。在我们的超球面参数化下，学习到的表示可以通过球面线性插值以闭式解的方式推断中间路径点，无需训练单独的高层策略或执行图搜索。重要的是，表示的几何结构还能告诉我们如何根据每个目标达成问题的难度来调整路径点的数量。实验表明，我们的方法在长时程导航和机器人操作任务上取得了成功，包括强基线方法失败的场景。
tldr: 该论文提出C-Slerp方法，利用超球面参数化的对比表示，通过球面线性插值以闭式解直接推断中间路径点，实现了无需奖励、演示或预训练模型的长时程规划与探索，成功完成最多八块立方体的搭建等复杂任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes C-Slerp, which leverages hyperspherical contrastive representations to infer intermediate waypoints in closed form via spherical linear interpolation, enabling planning and exploration from scratch without rewards, demonstrations, or pretrained models, and successfully solving long-horizon tasks such as building towers of up to eight cubes.
